create_node_merge_graph: create a Node instance and merge it with other nodes using merge and set_rep to track equivalence

find_concyclic_circles: find circles through all given points and explain why they are concyclic using circle_of_and_why

query_angle_ratios: query all angles or ratios between two directions or lengths using all_angles and all_ratios
